title: Water
fillNote: Adds fabrication-ready vector marks inside water areas. None keeps outlines only.
depthExaggerationNote: Relative to the terrain's vertical scale, which water already follows. 1× keeps lakes and sea floor on the same scale as the hills.
depthLayersLimited: Up to {count, plural, one {# layer} other {# layers}} ({depth} {unit}) below the lowest land. Land height stays unchanged.
fitLakeDepth: Fit lake depth to available layers
fitLakeDepthNote: Compresses lakes into your depth allowance while preserving their floor shape and shorelines. With fitting off, deeper areas are clipped.
depthLayersAutomatic: Automatic: adds all layers needed for the requested water depth. Currently {count, plural, one {# depth layer} other {# depth layers}} ({depth} {unit}) below the lowest land.
lakeDepthFitted: {name}: {exaggeration}× terrain depth applied · {percent}% of requested depth.
surveyedNote: Surveyed lake-floor data is used where available. Gaps use existing terrain or modeled depths.
modeledNote: Estimated from shoreline terrain slopes and GLOBathy/HydroLAKES depths. This is a modeled lake floor.
modeledNoteWithChart: Estimated from shoreline terrain slopes and GLOBathy/HydroLAKES depths. This is a modeled lake floor. A depth chart of your own replaces it.
insertsNeedDepth: Acrylic water inserts need {setting} on: they replace each lake on the sheet that carries its waterline.
insertProud: Thicker than the wood: the water will stand {height} {unit} proud of its shore.
showAllLakes: {count, plural, one {Show all # lakes} other {Show all # lakes}}
insertsNote: Each lake is cut out of the sheet at its waterline and filled with a fitted acrylic piece, exported as separate files. A 2 mm ledge on the sheet below holds it.
